title: Location
description: Location data stored in a companion text column next to a canonical native `text` column (which holds the display name/address). Self-describing via embedded `$schema` + `_type`. Coordinates are WGS84 (the GPS default). See notes/16.

geojson.description: Optional GeoJSON Point for interop, e.g. {"type":"Point","coordinates":[lng,lat]}.

examples.name: Eiffel Tower
examples.address: Champ de Mars, 5 Av. Anatole France, 75007 Paris, France
